 func TestAPI(t *testing.T) { TestingT(t) }
 
+// TestRemoteClusterHeartbeatSurvivesTunnelRemoval catches loss of the last
+// heartbeat when the newest or final tunnel connection is removed.
+func (s *AuthSuite) TestRemoteClusterHeartbeatSurvivesTunnelRemoval(c *C) {
+	const name = "remote.example"
+	rc, err := services.NewRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	rc.SetConnectionStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.CreateRemoteCluster(rc), IsNil)
+
+	got, err := s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+
+	old := time.Date(2020, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, time.FixedZone("offset", 3600))
+	latest := old.Add(time.Minute)
+	s.a.SetClock(clockwork.NewFakeClockAt(latest.Add(time.Second)))
+	for _, entry := range []struct {
+		name      string
+		heartbeat time.Time
+	}{{"older", old}, {"newer", latest}} {
+		conn, err := services.NewTunnelConnection(entry.name, services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+			ClusterName: name, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: entry.heartbeat,
+		})
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(conn), IsNil)
+	}
+
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(latest), Equals, true)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Location(), Equals, time.UTC)
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(name, "newer"), IsNil)
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(latest), Equals, true)
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(name, "older"), IsNil)
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(latest), Equals, true)
+
+	stored, err := s.a.Presence.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat().Equal(latest), Equals, true)
+}
+

+// UpdateRemoteCluster persists the remote cluster, including its status and expiry.
+func (s *PresenceService) UpdateRemoteCluster(ctx context.Context, rc services.RemoteCluster) error {
+	value, err := json.Marshal(rc)
+	if err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	_, err = s.Put(ctx, backend.Item{
+		Key:     backend.Key(remoteClustersPrefix, rc.GetName()),
+		Value:   value,
+		Expires: rc.Expiry(),
+	})
+	return trace.Wrap(err)
+}

 	startKey := backend.Key(remoteClustersPrefix)
